explanation: When the same entities participate in multiple relationships, labels distinguish the different meanings so the model is unambiguous.

options.text: They clarify which relationship is meant when the same entities are connected in more than one way
They eliminate the need for foreign keys
They turn a one-to-one relationship into a recursive relationship

prompt: A company has two different relationships between the same pair of entities, Employee and Department: one for where an employee works, and one for which department manages the employee record. Why are relationship labels useful here?
reviewConcept: Using relationship descriptors to distinguish meanings
